pages.title: Marte
pages.text: After you set foot on this gray planet and made various machines with Dais, you may want to go further. The crimson planet in the sky will be the next stop on your interstellar journey. Going to Mars requires a second-stage rocket, which is made with the same process as the first-stage rocket, but you need to use Dais materials instead of steel. Construct various parts and assemble your rocket in the NASA workbench, fill it with fuel, and go to Mars!

pages.title: purple gold
pages.text: Purple gold is a material unique to Mars and can be used to create more powerful space equipment, more remarkable machines, and rockets that can withstand extreme temperatures, allowing you to travel to extremely hot planets.
